$comment: Public Angular repositories the corpus check runs ng-checkup on, each pinned to one commit so a snapshot only changes when ng-checkup does. Chosen for spread: Angular 12 to 22, CLI and Nx workspaces, Ionic, small templates and a 180 000-line app, plus AngularJS apps in plain JavaScript and hybrid AngularJS/Angular apps. Move a commit only on purpose, in its own change, and update the snapshot with it.
